territory_notes.BRA: IBGE-sourced 2020 candidate polygon; historical correspondence and terrestrial support still require confirmation.
territory_notes.IDN: OSM-derived 2017 candidate boundary; archipelagic coverage, marine/land distinction and fixed-boundary correspondence require confirmation.
territory_notes.COD: OSM-derived 2017 candidate boundary; historical correspondence and terrestrial support require confirmation.
territory_notes.CMR: 2016 geoBoundaries/Wikimedia candidate polygon; positional detail and historical correspondence require confirmation.
territory_notes.CAN: 2020 OSM-derived candidate polygon extends north of the native biomass limit; the forest/biomass content of omitted support is unestablished.
territory_notes.FIN: 2017 OSM-derived candidate polygon; island coverage and historical/account-territory correspondence require confirmation; no separate ALA identifier occurs in the 2015 workbook inventory.
territory_notes.FRA: Candidate polygon spans metropolitan-European coordinates, including the Corsican component. GUF, GLP, MTQ, REU and MYT occur as separate workbook identifiers; this is not proof that all account components use exactly the same territorial convention.
territory_notes.AUS: 2021 ABS-sourced polygon includes outlying components (longitude range about 96.8 E to 168.0 E). CXR, CCK, NFK and HMD do not occur in the 2015 workbook inventory; absence of separate identifiers does not certify inclusion in AUS account components.

interpretation: Curated candidate matching notes, not certification or permanent exclusion
